# NEW 2026-11-22 v10.0 Worker 2 (Slot 77): Playable Poland-Lithuania Intermarium (oe_pplc_). Generated by gen_playable_plc.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Initialize Slot 77 global state (idempotent; read-only sync with Slot 49 oe_plc_).
oe_pplc_global_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_pplc_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_pplc_init value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_pplc_on value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_cnt value = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Initialize per-country Intermarium state variables safely.
oe_pplc_host_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_sejm_veto } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_sejm_veto value = 20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_cossack_register } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_cossack_register value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_intermarium } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_intermarium value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_warsaw_confed } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_warsaw_confed value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_hadiach_signed } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_hadiach_signed value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_may3_enacted } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_may3_enacted value = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Adjust Sejm Liberum Veto index by $delta$, clamped to 0..100 (0 when permanently abolished).
oe_pplc_shift_veto = {
	oe_pplc_host_init = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_pplc_veto_abolished }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_sejm_veto value = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		change_variable = { name = oe_pplc_sejm_veto add = $delta$ }
		clamp_variable = { name = oe_pplc_sejm_veto min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	oe_pplc_sync_veto_modifier = yes
}

# Country scope. Sync Liberum Veto paralysis modifier (uses mode = replace, never add_and_extend!).
oe_pplc_sync_veto_modifier = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_pplc_veto_crisis_active = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_pplc_veto_paralysis_mod } }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pplc_veto_paralysis_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_pplc_veto_paralysis_mod }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_pplc_veto_paralysis_mod
	}
}

# Country scope. O(1) recalculation of Intermarium sea-anchor count (0..3).
oe_pplc_recalc_intermarium = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_intermarium value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { oe_pplc_has_baltic_anchor = yes }
		change_variable = { name = oe_pplc_intermarium add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { oe_pplc_has_black_sea_anchor = yes }
		change_variable = { name = oe_pplc_intermarium add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { oe_pplc_has_southern_corridor = yes }
		change_variable = { name = oe_pplc_intermarium add = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Permanently abolish Liberum Veto and enact the Constitution of 3 May 1791.
oe_pplc_enact_may3_constitution = {
	oe_pplc_host_init = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_veto_abolished value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_may3_enacted value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_sejm_veto value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_pplc_veto_paralysis_mod }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_pplc_veto_paralysis_mod
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_pplc_ref_may_third_constitution } }
		add_reform = government_reform:oe_pplc_ref_may_third_constitution
	}
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pplc_intermarium_constitutional_hegemon_mod years = -1 mode = replace }
	add_stability = 12
	add_prestige = 25
}

# Country scope. Fire one event $ev$ on this host and record monthly spacing.
oe_pplc_fire_ev = {
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_cnt add = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pplc.$ev$
}

# Country scope. O(1) chronological & dynamic tick for the selected POL/LIT/PLC playable host.
oe_pplc_host_monthly_tick = {
	oe_pplc_host_init = yes
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { current_month = 1 current_month = 7 } }
		oe_pplc_recalc_intermarium = yes
		# Subtle policy drift on Liberum Veto index (semiannual O(1))
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_veto_abolished } }
			if = {
				limit = { oe_pplc_has_golden_liberty = yes }
				oe_pplc_shift_veto = { delta = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { OR = { oe_pplc_has_executionist_policy = yes oe_pplc_has_majority_sejm = yes } }
				oe_pplc_shift_veto = { delta = -2 }
			}
		}
	}
	oe_pplc_sync_veto_modifier = yes

	# At most 1 oe_pplc event per calendar month, and never same-month as Slot 49 oe_plc_!
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_pplc_ev_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
			NOT = { global_var:oe_plc_ev_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		}
		# Act I: 1388-1425 (anti-double-fire with Slot 49 Krewo/Grunwald)
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_1_fired }
				current_year >= 1388
				current_year <= 1435
				OR = {
					oe_pplc_slot49_grunwald_done = yes
					current_year >= 1412
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_1_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_2_fired }
				current_year >= 1454
				current_year <= 1500
				OR = {
					owns = location:gdansk
					owns = location:malbork
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_2_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 2 }
		}
		# Act II: 1505-1598
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_3_fired }
				current_year >= 1506
				current_year <= 1530
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_3_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_4_fired }
				current_year >= 1528
				current_year <= 1568
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_4_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_5_fired }
				current_year >= 1556
				current_year <= 1582
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_5_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_6_fired }
				current_year >= 1570
				current_year <= 1590
				OR = {
					oe_pplc_slot49_lublin_done = yes
					tag = PLC
					current_year >= 1573
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_6_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 6 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_7_fired }
				current_year >= 1574
				current_year <= 1600
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_7_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 7 }
		}
		# Act III: 1578-1735
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_8_fired }
				current_year >= 1578
				current_year <= 1625
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_8_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 8 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_9_fired }
				current_year >= 1600
				current_year <= 1645
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_9_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 9 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_10_fired }
				current_year >= 1650
				current_year <= 1680
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_10_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_11_fired }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_veto_abolished }
				current_year >= 1652
				current_year <= 1730
				OR = {
					oe_pplc_veto_crisis_active = yes
					AND = {
						current_year >= 1668
						has_variable = oe_pplc_sejm_veto
						var:oe_pplc_sejm_veto >= 45
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_11_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 11 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_12_fired }
				current_year >= 1660
				current_year <= 1740
				has_variable = oe_pplc_intermarium
				var:oe_pplc_intermarium >= 2
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_12_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 12 }
		}
		# Dynamic Vienna / Constantinople Relief
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_16_fired }
				current_year >= 1675
				current_year <= 1755
				OR = {
					country_exists = c:HAB
					country_exists = c:BYZ
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_16_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 16 }
		}
		# Act IV: 1720-1800
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_13_fired }
				current_year >= 1725
				current_year <= 1778
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_13_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 13 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_14_fired }
				current_year >= 1765
				current_year <= 1790
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_14_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 14 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_ev_15_fired }
				current_year >= 1788
				current_year <= 1805
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ev_15_fired value = 1 }
			oe_pplc_fire_ev = { ev = 15 }
		}
	}
}

# Slot 77 monthly entry point (called by mainline scheduler Slot 77 OR oe_pplc_fallback_pulse).
# Strictly idempotent per calendar month via oe_pplc_ran_m; O(1) <= 3 tags evaluated.
oe_pplc_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_pplc_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_pplc_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
		oe_pplc_global_init = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_pplc_on oe_pplc_any_alive = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = c:PLC c:PLC = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } }
				c:PLC = { oe_pplc_host_monthly_tick = yes }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { country_exists = c:POL c:POL = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } }
				c:POL = { oe_pplc_host_monthly_tick = yes }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { country_exists = c:LIT c:LIT = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } }
				c:LIT = { oe_pplc_host_monthly_tick = yes }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { country_exists = c:PLC c:PLC = { is_rebel_country = no } }
				c:PLC = { oe_pplc_host_monthly_tick = yes }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { country_exists = c:POL c:POL = { is_rebel_country = no } }
				c:POL = { oe_pplc_host_monthly_tick = yes }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { country_exists = c:LIT c:LIT = { is_rebel_country = no } }
				c:LIT = { oe_pplc_host_monthly_tick = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

# =============================================================================
# Dev Panel Page 77 Helper Effects (called by Stage gen_dev_mod.py Page 77)
# =============================================================================

# Dev Macro 1: Simulate Liberum Veto Sejm paralysis crisis (sejm_veto = 70) and fire oe_pplc.11.
oe_pplc_dev_macro_veto_crisis = {
	oe_pplc_global_init = yes
	oe_pplc_host_init = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_pplc_veto_abolished }
		remove_variable = oe_pplc_veto_abolished
	}
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_sejm_veto value = 70 }
	oe_pplc_sync_veto_modifier = yes
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pplc.11
}

# Dev Macro 2: Enact 1658 Treaty of Hadiach Tripartite Commonwealth + 1791 Constitution of 3 May.
oe_pplc_dev_macro_hadiach_may3 = {
	oe_pplc_global_init = yes
	oe_pplc_host_init = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_hadiach_signed value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_cossack_register value = 4 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_warsaw_confed value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_hussaria_ready value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_pplc_warsaw_toleration value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_pplc_intermarium_corridor value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_pplc_ref_tripartite_commonwealth } }
		add_reform = government_reform:oe_pplc_ref_tripartite_commonwealth
	}
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pplc_hadiach_tripartite_mod years = 40 mode = replace }
	oe_pplc_enact_may3_constitution = yes
	oe_pplc_recalc_intermarium = yes
}

# Dev Macro 3: Snapshot read-only state variables for oe_pplc.90 readout without mutating gameplay state.
oe_pplc_prepare_readout = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_veto value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pplc_sejm_veto } set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_veto value = var:oe_pplc_sejm_veto } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_cossack value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pplc_cossack_register } set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_cossack value = var:oe_pplc_cossack_register } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_intermarium value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pplc_intermarium } set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_intermarium value = var:oe_pplc_intermarium } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_hadiach value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pplc_hadiach_signed } set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_hadiach value = var:oe_pplc_hadiach_signed } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_may3 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pplc_may3_enacted } set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_may3 value = var:oe_pplc_may3_enacted } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_abolished value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pplc_veto_abolished } set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_abolished value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_warsaw value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pplc_warsaw_confed } set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_warsaw value = var:oe_pplc_warsaw_confed } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_s49_grunwald value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_grunwald_state } set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_s49_grunwald value = global_var:oe_plc_grunwald_state } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_s49_lublin value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_plc_lublin_state } set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_s49_lublin value = global_var:oe_plc_lublin_state } }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_ev_cnt value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_pplc_ev_cnt } set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_rd_ev_cnt value = global_var:oe_pplc_ev_cnt } }
}

# Dev Helper: Reset Slot 77 per-country test flags on current country.
oe_pplc_dev_reset = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_sejm_veto value = 20 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_cossack_register value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_intermarium value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_warsaw_confed value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_hadiach_signed value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_may3_enacted value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pplc_veto_abolished } remove_variable = oe_pplc_veto_abolished }
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_pplc_veto_paralysis_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_pplc_veto_paralysis_mod }
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_pplc_intermarium_constitutional_hegemon_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_pplc_intermarium_constitutional_hegemon_mod }
}
